A good match if you are drawn to devices and measurements that store and deliver electricity.

We study charge transfer and reactions at electrode–electrolyte interfaces.

  • Electrodes and catalyst supports for water electrolysis
  • Electrode materials for supercapacitors and batteries
  • Reactions at electrode–electrolyte interfaces
